description: Live availability of every service behind the RobotBase gateway: the chain nodes, Web3 Agent Hub, AITOKENS and MCP itself. When to use: an overall platform health check, or finding which service is down. Do not use: for a single chain's node state (chain_status) or its capability boundary (robotbase_capabilities). Returns: services[] {name, ok, detail} plus an overall ok flag.
name: robotbase_services
title: Robotbase Services
